name: Ryan Titus 2006 Fat Boy CVO
model: FLSTFSE2 Screamin Eagle Fat Boy CVO
notes: VIN 1HD1PNF156Y953325 | TC88B | counterbalanced | PV3 ANNI2000AA135349 fw 2.9.2-1715 | OEM CalID 141NY103-001 | stock 31.07 lb/hr injectors | Pro Pipes V&H true dual

tuning_guardrails.rationale: Bike has NO O2 or wideband sensors anywhere -- not in the head pipes, not in the collector, not after the muffler. AFR validation for any iteration must come from the dyno's tailpipe wideband sniffer (DynoWare RT). Closed-loop fuel-trim tables are not exported in either base.pvv or dynojet_stage.pvv so closed loop is inactive at the export level. CHT progression 189-208 F across iter_1 with one brief knock event at 5307 RPM motivates the 220 F abort threshold and 60 s cool-down. Analysis ceiling 5500 RPM is informational beyond peak HP; rev limit is at 6200 RPM (OEM, restored in iter_2). Knock retard cap of 4 deg surfaces real timing issues without masking them.
